_purpose: #3374 R1 — the committed cost-bearing-surface baseline. HAND-OWNED, deliberately NOT written by scripts/generate_platform_model.py: the generator derives the live counts into model/platform_model.json's cost_surface plane, and tests/test_platform_model_drift.py exact-pins this file against them. A PR that grows a cost-bearing population (a new schedule, alarm, EMF namespace, secret, or budget-guard AI feature) must bump the matching count HERE, in the same diff — that hand edit is the ratchet's deliberate act. A shrink must ratchet the count down the same way, so the baseline can never rot above the estate.
_last_change: #3620 (2026-09-19): secrets 28 -> 29 — ONE secret, `life-platform/ip-hash-salt`, the salt for the reader `ip_hash` on the six site-api engagement doors (/api/nudge, /api/submit_finding, /api/board_question, /api/predict, /api/ritual_log, /api/verify_subscriber). Cost-bearing surface named per #3374 R1: one Secrets Manager secret at $0.40/mo plus API calls, and the READ is bounded — one GetSecretValue per warm container per 15 min through the existing common/secret_cache, not one per request. No new Lambda, no new schedule, no new alarm, no new EMF namespace. It replaces an unsalted SHA-256 over a 2**32 IPv4 keyspace that was being written into S3 records, a DynamoDB sort key and CloudWatch logs. Owner-provisioned: until the secret exists the doors answer 503 by design (fail-closed, no unsalted fallback).
